<!-- Adding or updating a plugin: see README.md -->

- [ ] The version's entry is pinned with `node scripts/pin.mjs <link to kiwipot-plugin.json>`
- [ ] The release's links won't change (a GitHub release's files)
- [ ] `repository` is the plugin's source, and says how to build the script
- [ ] What it asks for (account, network) is what it needs, and the README of its repository says why
